messages:
marta: Heads-up: planning a promotion of payments-service chart into eu-west during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Changes: rate-limiter toggle + DB pool increase. Looping in @sanjay @emily to validate.
sanjay: Noted. Registry has chart v1.5.0, but the last eu-west stable is v1.4.2. v1.5.0 includes a sidecar image bump we haven't smoke-tested.
emily: The sidecar change removes env FE_JWT_TTL. App tolerates missing var, but a scheduled batch job relies on it. Need to confirm cron behavior.
deploy-bot: Promotion request queued: payments-service chart v1.5.0 -> eu-west (canary 10%, window 30m). Preflight: values schema OK, images resolvable, CI green.
tom: My 2c: consider pinning to v1.4.2 and applying values override for rate-limiter. Pin avoids the untested sidecar change during the window.
emily: Pin is fine but v1.4.2 lacks the new rate_limiter flag. We can enable the feature via Helm values override though.
marta: Proposed plan: manual canary at 5% on v1.5.0 for 30m with sidecar compat flags enabled (turn off risky behavior). If stable -> promote. If any regression -> immediate pin to v1.4.2.
sanjay: I'd prefer pin-first then hotpatch for rate-limiter, since payments are sensitive. But manual canary with conservative values is acceptable if oncall is ready.
tom: I'll be oncall. OK to proceed with manual 5% canary for 30m. Monitoring/rollback criteria: error-rate increase >1% or 95th latency +200ms.
emily: Values override for the canary (explicitly set sidecar compatibility):
```yaml
sidecar:
  compat_mode: true
payment:
  rate_limiter:
    enabled: true
  db:
    max_connections: 80
```
marta: Drafting release notes: "Introduce optional rate-limiter behind a feature flag; sidecar compat_mode enabled for eu-west canary. No expected user-facing changes."
sre-bot: Pre-canary checklist: dashboard https://dashboard.internal/payments-eu-west, runbook https://oncall.internal/runbooks/payments. Pager: @tom.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: payments-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (5%) at 3199990300. Monitoring window: 30m.
tom: Canary started. First 10m look good, no error spikes.
emily: Checked cron run logs on one canary pod: job completed with exit 0.
marta: If canary clean at 30m we go to 20%, then to 100% over an hour. On regression we pin to v1.4.2 (sha256:badc0ffee) and open a rollback postmortem.
sanjay: If we pin, I'll open a backport PR for the rate-limiter defaults so we can safely roll forward later.
deploy-bot: Canary passed at 3199990600 (30m). Scheduling 20% increment in 10m.
tom: 20% observation period looks stable.
sre-bot: Automated thresholds set: error-rate >1% or 95th +200ms will trigger rollback hold.
emily: Promoted to 100% at 3199990900. Post-promote smoke checks OK.
marta: Thanks all. I'm creating the release-note PR and including the emergency pin plan. Great execution.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: payments-service v1.5.0 -> eu-west (100%) at 3199991100. No rollback triggered. :tada:
